name: sendNotification
shortDescription: Sends a notification, such as an email, to a specified user with a custom subject and body.
description:
Overview

Sends an email notification to a specified user. This function acts as a wrapper for the platform's email service.

Intended use

Called by Lead Points or Admins from the UI, or by an AI agent (e.g., progressMonitoringAgent to alert about overdue tasks), to send direct communications. Parameters include recipientUserId, subject, and body.

Logic

  1. Retrieve the User record for params.recipientUserId using ctx.data.get. If not found, return an error.
  2. Use ctx.email.send to send an email to user.email with params.subject and params.body.
  3. Audit-log the notification send using ctx.audit.log, including the recipient and subject.
  4. Return a success response.

Entities

  • User

External Services

  • Email Service
